messages:
Anya Patel: Heads up — noticed a customer got billed for ~30 extra tokens when a streaming response + tool_call overlapped and the client truncated the stream. Feels like an off-by-one / prefix-trim mismatch in the router accounting.

Matt K: Can you paste the router logs + trace_id and a short repro? timestamps will help.

Anya Patel: Paste from the customer's trace: 
```
[router] ts=2071234567 trace=tr-9a1 offset=0 sent_tokens=75 event=chunk seq=3
[router] ts=2071234568 trace=tr-9a1 toolcall=start tool_id=kb_lookup prefix_len=67
[client] ts=2071234570 conn=987 closed=early truncation=true
[router] ts=2071234571 trace=tr-9a1 retry=1 replay_prefix=0-67
[ledger] ts=2071234572 trace=tr-9a1 charge provisional_tokens=75 finalized=false
```

Ryan O'Neill: From that it looks like: we snapshot prefix_len when the toolcall starts (67), then the client closes early so the stream retries and replays the same prefix. Our ledger currently writes a provisional charge when the chunk stream is emitted and then writes a final charge on completion — but we never dedupe provisional vs final on replay. So provisional + final = double charge.

Sophie L: This is killing support calls — the billing console only shows final charges and a total, not the provisional events. We need visibility (and a link to the trace) so CS can reconcile with a trace_id.

Anya Patel: Quick proposals: 
1) Attach a globally-unique sequence_id (trace_id + seq) to token events after a toolcall boundary and dedupe ledger entries on commit.
2) Treat charges created during streaming as "provisional/held" and only mark final after trailer or a short timeout (eg 20s) to handle client disconnects.
Both are backwards-compatible but different tradeoffs.

Matt K: Implementation notes: dedupe by seq_id requires a centralized provisional store keyed by seq_id with TTL and atomic compare-and-set on finalize. That will touch the hot path. Could be mitigated with sharded caches + write-behind to ledger. Need perf numbers.

Ryan O'Neill: Alternative: change model to "commit-on-final" for streams that include toolcalls — don't write provisional billing rows until finalization/toolcall completion. Simpler from reconciliation POV but increases risk of losing revenue if worker dies before finalization. Might be acceptable if we add a short checkpointing window.

deploy-bot: deploy v3.2.7 canary to us-east-1 at 2071234600 by ci/cd — note: this included the stream-prefetch patch that touched router replay logic.

Sophie L: Action items: 
- Create GH issue with decision matrix + perf/consistency tradeoffs. (I'll own console side: add provisional flag + trace link).
- Backend PoC for seq_id dedupe (Matt K).
- Anya to gather customer repros and upload traces.

Matt K: I'll open the GH issue: redwood/ledger#5025 and add a design sketch.

Anya Patel: Adding the customer trace link: https://internal.redwood/traces/tr-9a1 — repro + logs uploaded. @Ryan O'Neill can you take a look at the replay/dedupe edge?

Ryan O'Neill: Looking now. If we go seq_id dedupe we should also add reason codes to ledger rows (provisional/replayed/final) so the console can filter and we can build SLA alerts for "provisional held > timeout".
